products.title: Work Tracker Pro (Windows )
products.bodyText: Monitor and run your whole company, project, or business from one place
products.documentHtml:
Stop Losing Track. Start Delivering.

The All-In-One Executive Project Dashboard
That Turns Chaos Into Clarity.

Track strategic units, monitor 16 statuses in real time, generate board-ready reports, and never lose a day of progress — without touching the cloud.

Let's be brutally honest for a second.

You don't have a shortage of projects. You have a shortage of visibility into those projects.

You walk into a Monday morning meeting, and someone asks: "Where are we on the Downtown Bistro opening?" You open three spreadsheets, two email threads, and a sticky note from last Tuesday. By the time you piece together an answer, the room has moved on.

Teams drown in status updates that live in Slack threads, shared drives, and forgotten notebooks. Managers spend hours every week manually compiling "progress reports" that are stale the moment they're printed. Executives make decisions based on gut feeling because the data is scattered across six different tools.

This isn't just inconvenient. It's expensive. Delayed decisions cost real money. Missed deadlines lose clients. A blocked task nobody noticed for two weeks can derail an entire quarter.

Most project tracking fails not because people lack discipline, but because the tools are either too complex (Jira, Monday, Asana) or too simple (Excel, Notepad). One requires a training manual and a cloud subscription. The other gives you zero structure and zero insights.

There has to be a middle ground.

◆ ◆ ◆

Introducing Work Tracker Pro

Work Tracker Pro is the precision-built desktop dashboard designed for executives, operations managers, and business owners who demand real-time project visibility without the complexity of enterprise software.

It combines a spreadsheet-style project grid with a 16-status professional lifecycle system, live column analytics, one-click executive reports, and built-in progress tracking over time — all inside a single application that runs entirely on your computer.

"Work Tracker Pro is the tool that sits perfectly between a blank Excel sheet and an over-engineered cloud platform. It gives you just enough structure to be dangerous — and just enough simplicity to actually use it every day."

There is no cloud. No monthly subscription. No internet connection required. No login screen. You double-click one file, and your entire project portfolio loads instantly from a local database that you own.

The Features That Save You Hours Every Week

1. The 16-Status Professional Lifecycle

Every cell in your grid is not just a yes/no checkbox. It's a dropdown with 16 professionally defined statuses spanning five color-coded zones: Planned (grey), Working (blue), Warning (amber), Critical (red), and Complete (green). At a single glance, you can scan a grid of 50 cells and immediately see where the fires are burning — no reading required. Each status is shown as a colored dot and matching text on a uniform background — clean, readable, and designed for senior eyes.

2. Live Column Analytics (D / B / W / T)

Below every task column, four numbers update in real time: D = Done count, B = Blocked/Critical count, W = Working count, T = Total rows. You don't need to count anything manually. You don't need to run a separate report. The math lives right under the grid, updating the instant you change any status. Spot a column with high Blocked and low Done? That's where you send your attention today.

3. The Executive Report Generator

With one click on "Executive Report," your raw project grid transforms into a beautiful, print-ready analysis. You get: heatmap cards showing critical/warning/success breakdowns at a glance, a bar chart of all 16 status distribution counts, a numeric table for the detail-oriented, and Strategic Unit Health Scorecards — chunked stacked-bar charts with built-in donut charts showing aggregate zone proportions. Each section has a fullscreen maximize button so you can present charts on a projector. Optimized for A4 portrait. Print it. Save as PDF. Take it to the board.

4. Progress Tracking Over Time

Every time you save your project, Work Tracker Pro automatically records which cells are marked "Done." Click the 📈 Progress button to open a clean line chart: the X-axis shows real calendar dates, the Y-axis climbs from 0% to 100% as more tasks reach completion. A single status line beneath the chart tells you exactly where you stand: "17 / 60 Done (28%) — Started Jan 1, 2025 · 539 days." No manual data entry. No logging. It just works.

5. One-Click Database Backup & Restore

Your data is your business. Work Tracker Pro gives you two native Windows dialogs — a Save As window to export a time-stamped backup anywhere you choose, and a File Picker to restore from a previous backup. The restore process validates the database before replacing anything, so a corrupted file will never overwrite your live data. If the database file is ever deleted, a fresh one is created automatically on next launch. No recovery tools. No panic.

6. Smart Safety Guards

Navigate away with unsaved changes? A modal warns you. The Save Project button turns orange when anything is unsaved and green when everything is synced — you never wonder whether your work is safe. Each cell has a 32-character limit with a live floating counter that turns from green to amber to red as you type. Right-click any row label or column header to surgically delete just that element.

7. 100% Private & Fully Offline

Your project data lives in a local database file on your hard drive. Not on a cloud server in a data center you've never seen. Not behind a login screen owned by a company that could change its pricing tomorrow. There is no mandatory account, no monthly fee, no internet dependency. The software runs on your machine, your browser talks to a server that only exists on your localhost, and the port is dynamically assigned by the operating system — no conflicts, no configuration, no IT department required. It works on a fresh Windows 10 or 11 machine with zero dependencies.

How It Works: From Blank Grid to Boardroom Report

Step 1: Create Your Project

Click New Project +. Give it a title. The system auto-stamps today's date. You get a blank grid with default rows and columns — ready to customize immediately. You can have unlimited projects in a single database. Navigate between them with Prev/Next steppers or search by ID or name.

Step 2: Build Your Grid

Your rows are strategic units — departments, workstreams, initiatives, physical locations, whatever maps to your world. Your columns are task phases — Budgeting, Design, Construction, Training, Go-Live, or any sequence you name. Click Add Row + or Add Task + to expand. Labels are editable by clicking directly. The system monitors a 100-row and 50-column cap to maintain smooth performance even on older hardware.

Step 3: Assign Statuses

Click any cell. A dropdown appears with 16 options. Choose one. The dot and text change color instantly. The column analytics footer updates immediately. The Save button turns orange. Repeat for every cell that matters. In under a minute, you have a fully populated project grid that conveys more information than three pages of written status updates.

Step 4: Save & Track Progress

Click Save Project. The button turns green. The database records today's date for every cell marked "Done." Do this across multiple days or weeks, and the Progress chart builds a visual history of your project's completion over time. Each save adds a data point to the line chart. Over a month, you see a line climbing from 5% to 65% — undeniable proof of forward momentum.

Step 5: Report to Stakeholders

Click Executive Report. A full analysis appears: heatmap cards, status distribution chart, strategic unit health scorecards with donut charts. Click the fullscreen button to present on a projector. Print it. Save as PDF. Hand it to your investors, your board, your team. Every chart uses pitch-black fonts at readable sizes with clear legends — designed for senior decision-makers who value clarity over decoration.

Who Is This For?

  • The Senior Executive: You manage multiple initiatives across departments. You need a high-level dashboard that tells you in five seconds which projects are on track and which are bleeding. You don't want to learn a new platform. You want to open one screen, scan it, and make decisions.
  • The Operations Director: You oversee the gears that keep the company running. You have 10 strategic workstreams, each with 8-12 task phases. You need live column totals showing exactly where the bottlenecks are. You print reports for weekly leadership reviews.
  • The Small Business Owner: You're opening a restaurant, renovating a hotel, launching an apparel line, or expanding a service fleet. You have one shot to get the timeline right. Work Tracker Pro gives you a structured way to plan every phase and track every unit — without an IT budget.
  • The Consultant & Freelancer: You present status updates to clients who pay by the milestone. The Executive Report is your deliverable. Print it, email the PDF, or present it in a meeting. It looks like you spent hours preparing it. (You didn't.)
  • The IT Project Manager: You prefer offline, private tools that don't route your client's data through a third-party server. Work Tracker Pro sits on your local machine. No data leaves your network. No compliance headaches.

The Real Cost of Not Having This

Ask yourself these four questions:

  1. How many hours do you spend each week manually compiling status updates from emails, chat messages, and spreadsheets?
  2. What is the cost of a delayed decision because you couldn't see, at a glance, that a critical task had been blocked for two weeks?
  3. How many times have you walked into a meeting without a printed report because "the data wasn't ready"?
  4. What would happen to your projects if your laptop was lost or your cloud account was suspended?

If your honest answer to any of these questions makes you uncomfortable, Work Tracker Pro is your solution.

Think about what one missed deadline costs your business. A delayed store opening. A construction phase that runs 30 days over. A product launch that misses the holiday window. The gap between "I think we're on track" and "I can prove we're 78% done" is measured in thousands of dollars.

How We Compare

CapabilityExcel / SpreadsheetCloud PM ToolsWork Tracker Pro
Status lifecycle tracking✗ Manual coloring only✔ Often limited to 3-4 states✔ 16 professional statuses, 5 zones
Live column analytics✗ Formulas required✔ Varies by platform✔ D/B/W/T updates instantly in footer
Executive report with charts✗ Hours of manual work✔ Some platforms offer it✔ One click, print-optimized, pitch-black fonts
Progress tracking over time✗ No automatic tracking✗ Often an add-on or missing✔ Built-in — line chart with each save
Offline / private✔ Local file✗ Cloud-dependent✔ 100% local, no internet
One-click backup/restore✗ Manual copy✔ Varies by plan level✔ Native Windows Save As & restore with validation
No recurring cost✔ Free (but no structure)✗ $10-$40/user/month✔ One-time purchase, lifetime use
Learning curve✔ Familiar but unstructured✗ Days to weeks✔ Productive in first session

STOP TRACKING PROJECTS IN YOUR HEAD. START SEEING THEM.

Work Tracker Pro is not another monthly subscription you'll forget to cancel. It is a professional-grade tool you buy once and own forever. Download it. Double-click it. Be productive in under sixty seconds.

One-Time Payment. Lifetime Access. Fully Offline. Always Yours.

products.documentHtml:
Research Every Business Idea Before You Commit A Cent

Evaluate Any Business Idea In Minutes.
Get A Strategy. Not Just Hopes.

Browse 394 curated business ideas, stress-test the numbers like an investor, and generate a complete strategic report — one click, fully offline, no subscription.

Portable Single EXE 100% Offline No Sign-Up One-Time Purchase

Let's be brutally honest for a second.

Most people don't fail because they lack ambition. They fail because they pick an idea based on excitement instead of evidence.

You hear "dropshipping is profitable." You open a spreadsheet your friend sent you. You fill it with numbers you made up. You quit your job. Three months later, the spreadsheet was wrong.

Or the opposite: you have five ideas, and you can't decide. So you do nothing. Analysis paralysis costs more real money than any bad purchase — because time is the one asset you can't refund.

Meanwhile, professional investors don't "guess." They compare an idea against hundreds of alternatives, they model the costs, the revenue, the risk, and the payback. Then they decide. That's the entire difference.

You deserve the same discipline — but you don't need an MBA or a $200/month enterprise tool to get it.

◆ ◆ ◆

Introducing Startup Strategy Builder

Startup Strategy Builder is a portable desktop app that turns business-idea research into a repeatable, score-based process. It is built for founders, side-hustlers, students, and consultants who want investor-grade due diligence without the overhead of enterprise software.

It combines a library of 394 real business ideas, a budget-driven shortlist engine, a 3-pillar viability scoring model, and a one-click strategic report — all inside a single application that runs entirely on your computer.

"Most people don't need another business idea. They need a way to separate the profitable idea from the pretty idea — before spending money on it. Startup Strategy Builder gives you that system."

There is no cloud. No monthly subscription. No internet connection required. No login screen. You double-click one file, and your idea research opens instantly from a local database that you own. Everything you save lives on your hard drive — private, permanent, always yours.

The Features That Give You An Investor's Edge

1. 394 Business Ideas, Pre-Catalogued

No more staring at a blank page. The app ships with 394 real business ideas sorted by budget category — from micro-startups to high-budget ventures — each with a built-in risk profile and "why it works" reasoning.

2. Budget-Driven Shortlist

Tell the app what you can invest, and it instantly narrows 394 ideas down to the ones that fit your budget. High-demand, low-competition, and high-margin filters refine the list further.
If you want to add your new custom ideas you can, just click add.

3. The 3-Pillar Viability Score

Every idea is scored out of 10 across three pillars: Financial, Market, and Founder-Fit. No gut feeling — numbers drive the verdict.

4. Risk-Adjusted Real Math

Raw ROI, risk-adjusted ROI, payback period, market size, gross profit per sale, and monthly breakeven — every metric an investor would ask for, calculated live as you type.

5. One-Click Strategic Report

Turn any idea into a formatted strategy document with a final viability score and a written strategic recommendation. Print it or save it as PDF with Windows' built-in print dialog.

6. 12 Complete Example Projects

Pre-loaded, fully-worked examples — Online Store, Self-Storage, Restaurant, Bookstore and more — so you can study exactly how a profitable evaluation looks before doing your own.

7. Project Dashboard & Library

Every evaluation is saved automatically. Search by name, navigate with next/previous, and review every idea you've researched — your personal deal room.

8. 100% Private & Portable

Your data lives in a local database next to the app. Run it from your desktop, laptop, or a USB stick. No telemetry, no servers, no accounts. It's your business — nowhere else.

How It Works: From Blank Idea To Boardroom Report

  1. Pick Your Budget. Select the amount you can realistically invest. The idea library instantly narrows to what fits your range.

  2. Check The Idea. Tick the checkbox on any idea in the shortlist. Its built-in "why it works" reasoning appears with a default risk profile.

  3. Enter The Real Numbers. Startup cost, monthly revenue, expenses, market size, sale price, cost per sale, scalability. Every metric updates the live scores as you type.

  4. Save The Project. One click. Your evaluation is stored in your local project library — editable whenever you want.

  5. Get The Strategy Report. Generate the final report with a 0-10 viability score, risk assessment, and written recommendation. Print it or save as PDF.

Who Is This For?

  • The First-Time Founder: You have an idea and a limited budget. You need to know — before spending anything — whether it's worth pursuing. This is your due-diligence desk.

  • The Side-Hustler: You already have a job. You want a business that fits your budget and your risk tolerance. Stop debating five ideas; score them all in one afternoon.

  • The Student & Career-Changer: You're researching ideas for a class project or a life pivot. Use investor-grade logic and a printable report to back your decision.

  • The Mentor & Consultant: You advise small businesses. Run every client idea through the same scorecard, and hand them a professional viability report they can keep.

  • The Small Business Owner: You're tired of spreadsheet chaos. You want structure, saved projects, and a repeatable review process — without learning another cloud platform.

The Real Cost Of Guessing

Ask yourself these four questions:

  1. How much money have you spent on an idea that looked good for exactly one weekend?

  2. How many hours have you lost researching "business ideas" endlessly without getting closer to a decision?

  3. What is one bad startup bet worth — in cash, in time, and in confidence?

  4. If you had a score out of 10 for your idea today, supported by real numbers, would you decide faster?

If any of these questions made you pause, Startup Strategy Builder is your answer.

The tool costs a fraction of what one bad idea costs you. A single avoided misstep — a course you didn't buy, a franchise you didn't sign, a product line you didn't launch blindly — pays for it dozens of times over.

STOP GUESSING. START SCORING.

Startup Strategy Builder is not another monthly subscription you'll forget to cancel. It is a professional-grade research tool you buy once and own forever. Download it. Double-click it. Evaluate your first idea in under five minutes.

One-Time Payment. Lifetime Access. Fully Offline. Always Yours.


Learn More..

products.documentHtml:
Turn Ideas Into Plans. Turn Plans Into Progress.

Stop Chasing Everything.

Manage What Actually Matters.

A clean, focused project-and-task workspace that helps you organise goals, track progress, and stay on top of every detail — one click, fully offline, no subscription.

Portable Single EXE |100% Offline | No Sign-Up | One-Time Purchase


Let's be honest.

Most of us don't fail because we lack ambition — we fail because we carry too much in our heads. Every project, every task, every deadline is an open browser tab in your mind. And the more you hold onto, the more slips through.

You start a project with energy. Then the details pile up. Somewhere between "start date" and "deadline" the important tasks get buried under the urgent ones. You open ten notes apps and still can't find what you're supposed to do next.

Meanwhile, the tools meant to fix this are either monthly subscriptions, cloud accounts, or complicated systems that take more time to learn than they save.

You deserve a simpler answer — one that keeps your work private, on your machine, and ready in seconds.

◆ ◆ ◆

Introducing Goal Management System

Goal Management System is a portable desktop app that turns your goals into organised, trackable projects. It is built for professionals, teams, students, and busy individuals who want a clear, private workspace without the overhead of enterprise software.

It combines a visual task board, a goal-focused project workspace, and a live dashboard — all inside a single application that runs entirely on your computer.

"You don't need another to-do list. You need a way to see the big picture and the tiny details at the same time — without your data living on someone else's server."

There is no cloud. No monthly subscription. No internet connection required. No login. You double-click one file, and your workspace opens instantly from a local database that you own. Everything you save lives on your hard drive — private, permanent, always yours.

The Features That Keep You on Track

1. Visual Task Board

Organise tasks into clear status columns — Future, Underwork, Done, and On Hold. Drag and drop to move work forward and see progress at a glance.

2. Goal-Focused Project Workspace

Every project gets its own space with start and end dates, priority, and phase. One place to see what matters and when.

3. Prioritise by Urgency & Importance

Set urgency and importance on every task so you can focus on what truly moves the needle — not just what's loudest.

4. Live Dashboard

A clear dashboard with charts shows your task mix by status, urgency, and importance — so you always know where your attention is needed.

5. Search & Quick Navigation

Jump straight to any project with keyword search, or move next/previous through your library. Instantly load and edit.

6. Print-Ready Reports

Print a clean, professional report of any dashboard — perfect for meetings, reviews, and sharing progress with your team.

7. Your Examples Included

The app ships with pre-loaded example projects so you can see a fully-organised workspace before building your own.

8. 100% Private & Portable

Your data lives in a local database next to the app. Run it from a USB stick. No telemetry, no servers, no accounts.

How It Works: From Idea To Done

  • Create A Project. Give your goal a name, set the dates, priority, and phase. It appears in your workspace instantly.

  • Add Tasks. Break the project into tasks and drop them into the right status column — Future, Underwork, Done, or On Hold.

  • Set Urgency & Importance. Mark what's critical first so you always know what to tackle next.

  • Drag, Track & Save. Move tasks between columns as you work. One click saves your progress to your local library.

  • Review On The Dashboard. Open the dashboard to see your whole workload with charts — and print the report when you need it.

Who Is This For?

  • The Busy Professional: You juggle multiple projects. You need a private, no-nonsense workspace that opens in seconds and keeps you organised.

  • The Goal-Setters: You have big ambitions but too many unfinished lists. See your goals as structured projects and actually finish them.

  • The Student & Planner: Manage coursework, deadlines, and side projects in one place — without signing up for another cloud app.

  • The Team & Manager: Track shared work by priority and phase, and print clean reports for reviews and planning meetings.

  • The Privacy-Conscious User: You don't want your plans on a remote server. Your data stays on your own machine.

The Real Cost Of Staying Disorganised

Ask yourself these four questions:

  1. How many hours have you lost searching for a task or deadline that should have been visible at a glance?

  2. How many projects have stalled simply because the important work got buried under the urgent?

  3. What is one missed deadline or forgotten task worth — in credibility, in time, in stress?

  4. If all your work were organised in one private place, would you move faster?

If any of these made you pause, Goal Management System is your answer.

The tool costs a fraction of what disorganisation costs you. A single missed deadline — a client you didn't follow up with, a plan you didn't finish — pays for it many times over.

products.title: Risk Management System (Windows)
products.bodyText: Detect, manage, and monitor risks to protect your business. Get weighted scoring, 5×5 matrix, and mitigation tracking in a 100% offline desktop app with zero subscriptions and instant reports.
products.documentHtml:
Stop Tracking Risks In Spreadsheets You Can't Trust

Manage Every Risk With Real Numbers,

Not Gut Feeling.

Score, track, and mitigate risks with weighted category scoring, a 5×5 matrix, and instant print reports — one click, fully offline, no subscription.

5x5 Risk Matrix |100% Offline | Portable EXE | No Sign-Up | One-Time Purchase


Let's be brutally honest for a second.

Most companies don't fail because they lack ambition. They fail because they track risks in spreadsheets that nobody trusts, nobody updates, and nobody reads.

You have a risk register somewhere. It's an Excel file with 200 rows. Half the likelihood scores are outdated. The impact ratings were assigned by someone who left the company last year. The colors were meaningful once, but someone sorted the file and the conditional formatting broke.

Meanwhile, your board asks: "What are our top five risks?" You can't answer in 30 seconds. You have to dig through rows, manually re-sort, hope the formulas still work, and hope nobody notices you're guessing.

Or the opposite: you don't have a risk register at all. Risks live in people's heads. When someone leaves, their risks leave with them. When an auditor asks for evidence, you scramble to recreate something from memory.

Professional risk managers don't "hope for the best." They score every risk with a weighted model, link mitigation actions to specific risks, and generate a report that withstands board scrutiny. That's the entire difference.

You deserve the same discipline — but you don't need a $50,000 enterprise GRC platform to get it.

◆ ◆ ◆

Introducing Risk Management System

Risk Management System is is a professional local browser application that operates entirely on your PC to turn risk management into a repeatable, auditable process. It is built for risk managers, compliance officers, project managers, and small-to-mid-size companies who want enterprise-grade risk tracking without the enterprise-grade price tag.

It combines a weighted 5×5 risk matrix, category-weighted scoring, mitigation action tracking, change history, and instant print reports — all inside a single application that runs entirely on your computer.

"Most companies don't need more risk data. They need a way to separate the critical risk from the noise — before it becomes a headline. Risk Management System gives you that system."

There is no cloud. No monthly subscription. No internet connection required. No login screen. You double-click one file, and your risk register opens instantly from a local database that you own. Everything you save lives on your hard drive — private, permanent, always yours.

The Features That Give You Boardroom Confidence

1. Weighted 5×5 Risk Matrix

Every risk is plotted on a color-coded grid — green for low, red for extreme. Hover over any cell to see the risks inside. Editable appetite threshold shows which cells are Under or Over your risk tolerance.

2. Category-Weighted Scoring

Not all risks are equal. Strategic risks get 1.5x weight, Financial 1.4x, Compliance 1.3x, Reputational 1.2x, Safety 1.2x, Environmental 1.1x, Operational 1.0x. Your scores reflect what matters most.

3. Inline Editing Everywhere

Click any cell in the risk register, change the value, and it saves automatically. No modal dialogs. No form submissions. No browser popups. Edit probability, impact, status, owner, due date — all in one click.

4. Mitigation Action Tracking

Every mitigation action is linked to a specific risk. Track status — Pending, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled — and see exactly which controls reduce which risks.

5. One-Click Print Reports

Generate a landscape-formatted report with dashboard charts, risk register, risk matrix, mitigations, and change history. Print it or save as PDF with one click.

6. 5 Sample Projects, 150 Real Risks

Ships with complete projects covering inflation, supply chain, cyber threats, talent, ESG, compliance, and more — so you can study exactly how a mature risk register looks.

7. Multi-Project Support

Manage unlimited risk projects in a single application. Navigate between them with Prev/Next buttons. Each project has its own risks, mitigations, and history.

8. Dashboard & Charts

Pie chart, bar chart, doughnut chart, and top-5 highest risks — instant visual clarity on risk posture for the current project.

9. Notification Alerts

Bell icon shows overdue risks, due-soon risks, and upcoming reviews. Filtered by project so you only see what matters for the active project.

10. Change History (Audit Trail)

Every field edit is recorded with timestamp, old value, new value, and user. Filtered by project. Immutable and complete — ready for compliance audits.

11. Residual Risk Scoring

Set residual likelihood and impact after mitigation. See the gap between your raw score and residual score — proof that your controls are working.

12. 100% Private & Portable

Your risk data lives in a local database next to the app. No servers, no accounts, no third party ever sees your risks. Copy the folder to another machine and it works.

How It Works: From Blank Register To Board Report

  • Double-Click The .exe. The application launches instantly in your browser. No installation. No configuration. It loads with 5 sample projects and 150 pre-loaded risks.

  • Navigate Projects. Use Prev/Next to move between projects. Create a new project with +New. Each project is independent with its own risks, mitigations, and history.

  • Add Risks. Type a risk title, select Probability and Impact from dropdowns, click Add Risk. Edit every field inline — it saves automatically. No browser popups, no modals.

  • Link Mitigations. For each risk, add mitigation actions. Track status (Pending, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled). See the residual risk score after controls are applied.

  • Review & Report. Check the dashboard for visual summary. Review change history for audit trail. Click Print to generate a landscape report — save as PDF.

Who Is This For?

  • The Risk Manager: You need a structured, auditable risk register that your board can trust. Stop recreating spreadsheets from scratch every quarter. This is your system of record.

  • The Compliance Officer: Auditors want evidence. Change history provides a complete, immutable audit trail. Every modification is timestamped and traceable.

  • The Project Manager: You're tracking risks across multiple initiatives. Each project gets its own register, its own mitigations, and its own history — all in one app.

  • The Small Business Owner: You don't have a risk team. You need something simple that works on your laptop. Double-click the .exe and you're running. No training required.

  • The Consultant: You manage risks for multiple clients. Create a project per client, track their risks, and hand them a print-ready report at the end of the engagement.

  • The C-Suite Executive: You want dashboard visibility into risk posture. One glance at the charts tells you where the company stands — no spreadsheet gymnastics required.

Who Can Use This

A general-purpose risk register, suitable for any organization or team with defined risks and named risk owners.

  • Industries: Banks & financial services, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, construction, IT/software, cybersecurity, logistics & supply chain, energy/oil & gas, government/regulatory bodies, consulting, pharma, telecom, retail, startups, universities, NGOs, real estate, aviation, agriculture.

  • 20+ use cases: Supplier/vendor risk, project delivery risk, cybersecurity assessment, business continuity, compliance & audit evidence, financial/credit risk, health & safety registers, quality failure modes, data privacy (GDPR/HIPAA), strategic/market risk, due diligence, ESG, fraud/AML, workforce/HR risk, change management (M&A), product launch, insurance underwriting tables, internal-audit findings, and more.

  • The value: A 5×5 Likelihood x Impact matrix, weighted category scoring, mitigation tracking, auditable change history, professional print/PDF reports — fully offline and portable.
